docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Abhinaya Darpaṇa of Nandikeśvara, the classical Sanskrit manual of gesture in Indian dance and drama, with the hand-gestures (hastas) illustrated, in English (Cambridge, Mass., 1917). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The mirror of gesture, being the Abhinaya darpana of Nandikeśvara · Nandikeśvara, Coomaraswamy, Ananda Kentish, 1877-1947, Gopala Kristnayya Duggirala · 1917, 104 scanned pages. Published 1917; Ananda K. Coomaraswamy died 1947 and Gopala Kristnayya Duggirala 1928; the text is medieval; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
